body:
**Starts** once #60 is merged. #59, #197, #198, and #199 are its other needs, and #60 waits for them too.

The leg scout's code doesn't need the stay researcher's. It waits for #60 because both workers share the coordinator's side: #60 writes the fill-round instructions, the worker brief outline, and the text on each candidate field, and the leg scout uses all three. Built at the same time, both PRs would write those, and Joe would review two versions of each. Waiting also lets what the first worker shows feed the second. And the last "Done when" item needs both workers.

## Why

The leg scout fills the stops along a day's drive, such as lunch on the way or a viewpoint, with candidates and their detour times (technical spec 6.2). It's the second worker. During the fill round, it runs at the same time as the stay researchers, all saving to the same trip.

## Design

- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), sections 6.2 and 6.5 (how a worker is started, its brief, its result, and the hooks and settings).
- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), sections 2.1 (detour times and `read_worker_brief_facts`), 2.6 (`report_result`), 3, and 4.
- [Domain model](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/domain-model.md), section 4.7.

## Open questions

- ~~What timeout does each Google call get, and what time limit does the whole write get? One write can make several calls, such as selecting Moab lodging, which re-routes four days. Measure real writes first.~~ **Settled on 2026-10-28 in chat:** keep the 10-second timeout each Google call already has (`TIMEOUT_MILLISECONDS` in `src/google/routes-client.ts` and `src/google/places-client.ts`), add no time limit for the whole write, and keep the lock wait at 5 seconds and 3 tries (persistence design section 4). Real writes were measured against Google and the local Postgres. Only Routes calls run while a write holds the trip's lock. `LegsService.updateLegs()` re-routes the days in parallel, and a write is at most 3 calls deep: a route, the best-order check, and one more route. Selecting Moab lodging (Days 1, 2, and 4, 6 or 7 calls) held the lock 0.3 seconds at most, and only about 14 ms of that was the app and the database. A leg scout's `add_stop_candidates` with 3 detour times held it about 0.1 seconds. The slowest single Routes call was 0.26 seconds. A leg scout and two stay researchers writing to one trip at once waited 0.2 seconds at most for the lock, and nothing was refused. A whole-write limit isn't needed, since 3 calls deep at 10 seconds each already caps a write's Google time at 30 seconds, and the limit would need a cancel signal passed through the route code. It's now a point under "Do".

## Do

- Add the leg scout and its instructions. Use #60's text on each candidate field, and on problems and questions, word for word: `CANDIDATE_FIELDS` and `PROBLEMS_AND_QUESTIONS` in `src/agent/worker-instructions.ts`. Its instructions name the worker brief's headings from `WORKER_BRIEF_HEADING` in the same file. The leg scout gets no `WebFetch`, so a place it finds on Atlas Obscura takes the page's link from the search result. #199 already built the detour times in `add_stop_candidates`.
- Extend the coordinator's fill-round instructions and the worker brief outline from #60 to cover the leg scout's worker brief. Replace the last point of the "Workers" section in `src/agent/coordinator-prompt.ts`, which #60 added while there was no leg scout: "Stops along a leg, or near the start or end place, have no worker yet. Leave them empty, and tell the user they can name a place for one." Drop the sentence about it from technical spec 5.2's bullet on when to send work to a worker too.
- Give the leg scout a definition as technical spec 6.5 says, with its tools from tool design section 3, and add `leg-scout` to the coordinator's `Agent(...)` entry. #198 already puts `search_along_leg` on the `places` server, hidden from the coordinator.
- Add a model setting and an effort setting for the leg scout, like the stay researcher's, and pass both into its definition. Each agent has its own, so one agent's model or effort can change and be evaluated alone. Decided on 2026-10-28 in chat, in place of #208. Both start as the stay researcher's do: `claude-sonnet-5-5` and `medium`. It does the same kind of work as the stay researcher: it judges tiers and fits places to the user's words, and several run at once in the fill round. Add the two rows to technical spec section 10, as "Leg scout model" and "Leg scout effort". Decided on 2026-10-28 in chat.
- Add the hook that denies a leg scout's web search unless it's limited to `atlasobscura.com`.
- In persistence design section 4, change both places that say a write holds the lock "a few seconds at most" (in "The cost is waiting" and "A write waits 5 seconds for the lock") to say it holds it well under a second: 0.3 seconds at most, when real writes were measured on 2026-10-28 (the settled question above). Leave the timeouts and the lock wait as they are.
- Say in the leg scout's instructions that nobody reads its own messages, and that the coordinator gets only what its tool calls saved and what it passes to `report_result`. The stay researcher's instructions say this in their "Your work, in order" section (`src/agent/stay-researcher-prompt.ts`). Claude Code adds a note to every worker's system prompt that pulls the other way: "Return findings directly as your final assistant message — the parent agent reads your text output, not files you create." Settled in #194.

## Done when

- The leg scout for San Francisco Day 2 (domain model, section 5.1) fills Point Lobos, Bixby Creek, and lunch with candidates that have detour times.
- A test shows the hook denies a leg scout's search with no domain limit.
- Two stay researchers and a leg scout run at once, and none loses another's candidates.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.

---

Moved from the [development plan](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/plan/development-plan.md#phase-28-the-leg-scout).
